areas.name: Tables
areas.brief: Insert a 3x3 table with header row. Add and remove rows and columns, merge nothing. Type in cells, tab between cells, delete a table. Check the LaTeX output is a tabular with the right column count and that it round-trips back into an editable table.

areas.name: Lists and nesting
areas.brief: Bulleted and numbered lists, nesting with Tab and outdenting with Shift+Tab, Enter creating a new item, Enter on an empty item leaving the list, converting a list to paragraphs, mixed nested itemize/enumerate. Check LaTeX.

areas.name: Math (inline and display)
areas.brief: Insert inline math and display equations, edit existing math by clicking it, use invalid LaTeX and confirm the error is shown not swallowed, delete a math node, verify $...$ and equation environments in the source, round-trip.

areas.name: Links, citations, footnotes, cross-references
areas.brief: Add a link (with and without a URL, edit, remove), insert a citation (bib key present/absent), insert a footnote and edit its text, insert a cross-reference, verify \href, \cite, \footnote, \ref output and that editing flows work.

areas.name: Review: comments and tracked changes
areas.brief: Add a comment to a selection, reply, resolve, delete. Make an edit that should create a revision, accept it, reject it, check the History panel. Verify visual-only review state never leaks into the exported LaTeX.

areas.name: LaTeX source editor
areas.brief: Switch to source, edit the LaTeX by hand (add a section, a table, a math environment), switch back to visual and confirm the change appears. Introduce broken LaTeX and confirm the app reports it instead of wiping the document. Check undo in source mode.

areas.name: Long document behaviour
areas.brief: Paste a few thousand words and 50 headings, then check scrolling, outline population, word count, page count, typing latency, and that the outline stays in sync while editing. Look for content loss at page boundaries.

areas.name: Persistence and recovery
areas.brief: Type, wait for autosave, reload the page, confirm the document is restored. Check the saved indicator tells the truth. Try rapid edits, undo after reload, and check for data loss on navigation away.

areas.name: Keyboard and accessibility
areas.brief: Tab through the ribbon and dialogs, check focus visibility, Escape closes overlays, Ctrl+S/Ctrl+Enter/Ctrl+B/I/U, Home/End/Selection with Shift, screen-reader-ish labels on icon-only buttons, and that every action has a keyboard path.

areas.name: Images and page furniture
areas.brief: Insert an image (browser picker is stubbed — record the graceful failure), insert a page break, insert a table of contents, check rendering, and check the LaTeX for includegraphics, \newpage and \tableofcontents.
